review.tagline: Native macOS terminal with vertical tabs and agent notifications
review.summary: cmux is a Swift/AppKit macOS terminal built on libghostty that reads your existing Ghostty config. It adds a sidebar showing git branch, PR status, working directory and ports per workspace, plus notification rings driven by OSC 9/99/777 sequences or `cmux notify` from agent hooks. It also has an in-app scriptable browser, SSH workspaces, and a CLI and Unix socket API.
review.audience: macOS developers running several terminal coding agents in parallel
strengths: Native Swift/AppKit app, not Electron; libghostty rendering and reads existing Ghostty config
Works with any agent that runs in a terminal; hooks for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and others
Everything scriptable through CLI and Unix socket, including browser automation and split panes
Session restore of layout, scrollback and supported agent sessions via `cmux hooks setup`
weaknesses: macOS only; no Linux or Windows build
License detected as NOASSERTION; README says GPL, so check terms
Does not checkpoint live processes; needs opt-in tmux or zellij for detach/reattach
iOS companion is beta, with early access tied to the Founders Edition
needs: Models: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Amp
